label: Fullbright
description: Raises gamma so caves and shadows are fully lit.
settings_description: Settings for the Fullbright gameplay mod. Overrides `gameSettings.gammaSetting`; client-side only and Watchdog-tolerated (§3), but classified `grey` in §11.

gamma.description: Value written to `gammaSetting` while the mod is on. Vanilla's slider tops out at 1; 10 is the conventional fullbright value.
